methods.doc: SetIcon writes the /Name entry.

methods.name: Open
methods.doc: Open returns the /Open flag (whether the popup is initially shown).

methods.name: SetOpen
methods.doc: SetOpen writes the /Open flag.

methods.name: RegenerateAppearance
methods.doc: RegenerateAppearance is a no-op for TextAnnotation (no /AP — viewers render the icon themselves).

name: NewTextAnnotation
doc: NewTextAnnotation builds an unbound text-note annotation.

name: TestSubepic2FilterByType
doc: TestSubepic2FilterByType verifies that Text, FreeText, and Stamp annotations can coexist on one page and each round-trips to the correct AnnotationType after a save / re-open cycle.

name: TestSubepic2RegenerateAppearance
doc: TestSubepic2RegenerateAppearance verifies that RegenerateAppearance() is callable without error on all three text-bearing annotation types.

name: TestSubepic2CoexistsWithSubepic1And3
doc: TestSubepic2CoexistsWithSubepic1And3 verifies that Subepic 2 (Text/FreeText/Stamp) annotations coexist with Subepic 1 (Link/Highlight) and Subepic 3 (Square) types on the same page, all round-tripping to the correct types after save/re-open.

name: TestSubepic2RemoveUnusedObjects
doc: TestSubepic2RemoveUnusedObjects verifies that after SetCustomImage + ClearCustomImage, the image XObject becomes orphan and RemoveUnusedObjects reclaims it (returns removed count ≥ 1).

name: LineCap
doc: LineCap is the /J line cap style per ISO 32000-1 §8.4.3.3 Table 54.

name: LineJoin
doc: LineJoin is the /j line join style per ISO 32000-1 §8.4.3.4 Table 55.

name: Bytes
doc: Bytes returns the accumulated content-stream bytes.

name: PushState
doc: PushState saves the current graphics state (q operator).

name: PopState
doc: PopState restores the last saved graphics state (Q operator).

name: ConcatMatrix
doc: ConcatMatrix concatenates the given 2x3 matrix to the CTM (cm operator).

name: SetLineWidth
doc: SetLineWidth sets the stroke line width (w operator).

name: SetLineCap
doc: SetLineCap sets the line-cap style (J operator).

name: SetLineJoin
doc: SetLineJoin sets the line-join style (j operator).

name: SetMiterLimit
doc: SetMiterLimit sets the miter limit (M operator).

name: SetStrokeColorRGB
doc: SetStrokeColorRGB sets the stroke color to RGB (RG operator).

name: SetFillColorRGB
doc: SetFillColorRGB sets the fill color to RGB (rg operator).

name: SetStrokeGray
doc: SetStrokeGray sets the stroke color to a grayscale value (G operator).

name: SetFillGray
doc: SetFillGray sets the fill color to a grayscale value (g operator).

name: MoveTo
doc: MoveTo begins a new subpath at (x, y) (m operator).

name: LineTo
doc: LineTo appends a straight line segment to (x, y) (l operator).

name: CurveTo
doc: CurveTo appends a cubic Bezier curve from the current point through control points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) to endpoint (x3, y3) (c operator).

name: ClosePath
doc: ClosePath closes the current subpath (h operator).

name: Ellipse
doc: Ellipse adds a closed elliptic subpath centered at (cx, cy) with semi-axes rx and ry, approximated by 4 cubic Beziers and an explicit h operator so the subpath is marked closed (matters for stroke joins at the seam point per ISO 32000-1 §8.5.2.1).

name: Stroke
doc: Stroke strokes the current path (S operator).

name: ClosePathStroke
doc: ClosePathStroke closes and strokes the current path (s operator).

name: Fill
doc: Fill fills the current path using the non-zero winding rule (f operator).

name: FillStroke
doc: FillStroke fills then strokes the current path (B operator).

name: ClosePathFillStroke
doc: ClosePathFillStroke closes, fills, then strokes the current path (b operator).

name: EndPath
doc: EndPath discards the current path without painting (n operator).

name: DoXObject
doc: DoXObject invokes a previously-registered Form or Image XObject by resource name (Do operator).

name: BeginMarkedContentText
doc: BeginMarkedContentText opens a "/Tx BMC" marked-content section.

name: EndMarkedContent
doc: EndMarkedContent closes a marked-content section (EMC operator).

name: ClipRect
doc: ClipRect intersects the clip path with the given rectangle (re W n).

name: TextLine
doc: TextLine emits one positioned line of text: BT, font + size, fill colour, an absolute text position, the (already PDF-escaped, paren- wrapped) string, then ET.

name: TestDrawLineEndingNone
doc: drawLineEnding emits content-stream operators.

name: TestAnnotColorFromComponents
doc: TestAnnotColorFromComponents covers the 1/3/4-number annotation colour arrays (DeviceGray / DeviceRGB / DeviceCMYK) and the empty/absent case.

name: TestSquareInteriorColorComponents
doc: TestSquareInteriorColorComponents checks /IC parsing accepts gray and CMYK, not just RGB (34415.pdf fills its first two rectangles with 1- and 4-component interior colours).

name: TestSquareAppearanceNoColorIsEmpty
doc: TestSquareAppearanceNoColorIsEmpty checks that a Square with neither /C nor /IC paints nothing — no default black border invented by the synthesizer (34415.pdf's fourth rectangle has both absent and must render blank).

name: TestFreeTextAPVAlignDiffersByPosition
doc: TestFreeTextAPVAlignDiffersByPosition verifies that the text baseline Y coordinate inside /AP/N differs correctly for VAlignTop, VAlignMiddle, and VAlignBottom on an identical FreeTextAnnotation rect.

name: BmpDevice
doc: BmpDevice renders a page to BMP.

methods.name: Process
methods.doc: Process renders page and writes it to w as BMP.

name: NewBmpDevice
doc: NewBmpDevice returns a BmpDevice for the given resolution.

name: TestSavePreservesCatalogFields
doc: TestSavePreservesCatalogFields verifies that catalog-level fields other than /Pages survive a Save + Reopen roundtrip.

name: TestCCITTTablesBuilt
doc: TestCCITTTablesBuilt spot-checks a few well-known T.4 run-length codes.

name: TestCCITTWhiteMakeupCodes
doc: TestCCITTWhiteMakeupCodes verifies every white make-up code (64..1728) against the canonical ITU-T T.4 Table 2 bit patterns.

name: TestCCITTDecodeHorizWideWhite
doc: TestCCITTDecodeHorizWideWhite decodes a single 1728-column Group 4 row coded in horizontal mode with a full-width white run via make-up 1728 — one of the codes that was wrong (0x97 instead of 0x9B).

name: TestCCITTDecodeAllWhite
doc: TestCCITTDecodeAllWhite decodes a Group 4 stream of all-white rows: each row is a single V0 mode bit ('1').

name: TestCCITTRejectsGroup3TwoD
doc: TestCCITTRejectsGroup3TwoD checks that mixed Group 3 2-D (/K>0) is reported as unsupported rather than mis-decoded.

name: TestCCITTGroup3EOL
doc: TestCCITTGroup3EOL verifies the Group 3 1-D decoder consumes EOL codes (000000000001, optionally fill-bit padded) that delimit each line.

name: TestParseCFFCurveGlyph
doc: TestParseCFFCurveGlyph checks the cubic curve operator (rrcurveto) is interpreted and flattened into a multi-point on-curve contour that bulges out to the control hull.

name: TestCFFStdStrings
doc: TestCFFStdStrings sanity-checks the standard strings table against known SIDs (CFF spec Appendix A): the glyph-name lookups behind the PDF-encoding → charset path depend on these exact positions.

name: TestCFFGlyphNameRune
doc: TestCFFGlyphNameRune covers the AGL lookup plus the uniXXXX / uXXXX forms used by subset fonts for non-standard glyph names.

name: TestChangePassword
doc: TestChangePassword re-encrypts an encrypted document with a new password, keeping the original algorithm and permissions: the old password must stop working, the new one must open it, and the content/permissions survive.

name: TestChangePasswordPlaintext
doc: TestChangePasswordPlaintext returns an error on a document that is not encrypted (there is no password to change).

name: TestPredefinedCMapDecode
doc: TestPredefinedCMapDecode verifies the predefined Adobe CJK CMaps decode the variable-width codespace to the right CIDs, and that the per-ordering CID→Unicode tables map those CIDs to the expected characters.

name: TestCJKAsciiFallback
doc: TestCJKAsciiFallback verifies Latin codes that a CJK CMap maps to proportional-Latin CIDs (with no Unicode in Adobe's table) fall back to the ASCII code itself, so "ABC" inside a GBK font still resolves.

name: TestPredefinedCMapUsecmap
doc: TestPredefinedCMapUsecmap verifies a CMap that chains another via usecmap inherits the parent's ranges (ETenms-B5-H usecmap ETen-B5-H).

name: TestAdobeCMYKToRGB
doc: TestAdobeCMYKToRGB checks the baked Adobe-profile LUT reproduces the process colours (matching Acrobat/MuPDF) and interpolates interior colours — in particular the purple that the naive (1-C)(1-K) formula rendered too blue.

name: Color
doc: Color represents an RGBA color with values in [0, 1].

name: HAlign
doc: HAlign specifies horizontal text alignment within a rectangle.

name: VAlign
doc: VAlign specifies vertical text alignment within a rectangle.

name: TextStyle
doc: TextStyle defines reusable text formatting properties.

name: TestResolveFontType3WidthsFontMatrix
doc: TestResolveFontType3WidthsFontMatrix verifies Type3 /Widths are normalized through /FontMatrix to the 1000-units-per-em convention (ISO 32000-1 9.6.5).

name: TestDifferencesGlyphNames
doc: TestDifferencesGlyphNames verifies raw /Differences names are recorded for by-name glyph lookup (40869.pdf: ZapfDingbats /a71 legend dots are outside the AGL, unreachable through runes).

name: TestFontStyleFromItalicAngleAndWeightName
doc: TestFontStyleFromItalicAngleAndWeightName verifies oblique is detected from /ItalicAngle and bold from a foundry weight word (Demi), even when the /Flags italic/bold bits and the "bold"/"italic" keywords are absent (37842_37843_9.pdf: URWGothicL-DemiObli substituted upright-regular before).

name: TestDecryptStreamInPlaceASCII85
doc: TestDecryptStreamInPlaceASCII85 is the core regression test for pdf-go-2qq.

name: TestASCII85DecodeRejectsInvalidBytes
doc: TestASCII85DecodeRejectsInvalidBytes verifies that ascii85Decode returns an error for bytes that lie outside the valid ASCII85 alphabet (0x80–0xFF etc.).

name: TestASCII85DecodeAcceptsValidInput
doc: TestASCII85DecodeAcceptsValidInput ensures the fix did not regress normal decoding — valid ASCII85 data must still decode correctly.

name: TestEncryptDecryptRoundTripFiles
doc: TestEncryptDecryptRoundTripFiles is the headline integration test for the encryption epic: take a real testdata PDF, capture its per-page extracted text, encrypt with both user and owner passwords, save to a real file, reopen via OpenWithPassword, capture per-page text again, and assert byte-for-byte equality.

name: TestEditInPlaceEncrypted
doc: TestEditInPlaceEncrypted exercises the full edit-in-place workflow that motivated password-aware Open: open an encrypted file, mutate it, save with encryption preserved, and verify that BOTH the original content and the new content come back on the next open.

name: TestPermissionsSurviveRoundTrip
doc: TestPermissionsSurviveRoundTrip pins the new Permissions() getter and permissions preservation across Save+OpenWithPassword.

name: TestPermissionsOnUnencryptedDocument
doc: TestPermissionsOnUnencryptedDocument verifies the getter contract for the unencrypted case: zero value plus !ok.

name: TestRemoveEncryption
doc: TestRemoveEncryption verifies the explicit decryption API: open with password, RemoveEncryption, Save → result is a plain PDF.

name: TestEditInPlacePreservesOriginalPasswords
doc: TestEditInPlacePreservesOriginalPasswords verifies that opening an encrypted file with one password and re-saving (without any explicit SetPassword/SetEncryption call) keeps BOTH original passwords working.

name: TestExplicitSetPasswordOverridesPreservation
doc: TestExplicitSetPasswordOverridesPreservation verifies that calling SetPassword after OpenWithPassword drops the preserved state so that old passwords no longer work and the new password does.

name: TestOpenWithPasswordRoundTrip
doc: TestOpenWithPasswordRoundTrip is the central correctness test for the password-aware Open path: encrypt a document, reopen it with the same password, extract its text, compare against the original.

name: TestOpenWithOwnerPassword
doc: TestOpenWithOwnerPassword verifies the owner password also unlocks.

name: TestOpenEncryptedReturnsErrEncrypted
doc: TestOpenEncryptedReturnsErrEncrypted: plain Open on an encrypted file must return a sentinel ErrEncrypted error so callers can switch to the password-aware path.

name: TestOpenWithWrongPassword
doc: TestOpenWithWrongPassword: a wrong password must fail clearly.

name: TestOpenWithPasswordOnPlainPDF
doc: TestOpenWithPasswordOnPlainPDF: opening an unencrypted file with a password is allowed and equivalent to plain Open.

name: Document
doc: Document is a PDF document.

methods.name: FiguresNeedingAltText
methods.doc: FiguresNeedingAltText walks the document's logical structure tree and returns every /Figure element that lacks alternate text (/Alt or /ActualText), each paired with the image it brackets when that image can be located.

methods.name: PageCount
methods.doc: PageCount returns the number of pages in the document.

methods.name: Pages
methods.doc: Pages returns a live view of all pages in the document.

methods.name: Page
methods.doc: Page returns a live view of the page at the given 1-based number.

methods.name: Append
methods.doc: Append adds all pages from others to this document, merging their objects.

methods.name: RemoveUnusedObjects
methods.doc: RemoveUnusedObjects removes objects from the document that are not reachable from any page.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.doc: SetPassword configures the document to be encrypted when saved.

methods.name: SetPermissions
methods.doc: SetPermissions configures what operations a viewer allows on the encrypted document (printing, copying, modifying, etc.).

methods.name: Permissions
methods.doc: Permissions returns the viewer-permission settings currently configured on this document, plus a boolean indicating whether the document is configured for encryption at all.

methods.name: RemoveEncryption
methods.doc: RemoveEncryption clears any previously configured encryption (passwords and permissions) so the next Save produces a plaintext PDF.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.doc: ChangePassword re-encrypts the document with new passwords on the next Save, keeping the current encryption algorithm and permissions.

methods.name: SetEncryption
methods.doc: SetEncryption configures every encryption-related setting at once from an EncryptionOptions struct.

methods.name: WriteTo
methods.doc: WriteTo writes the document to w.

methods.name: Save
methods.doc: Save writes the document to outputPath.

methods.name: AddBlankPage
methods.doc: AddBlankPage appends a blank page to the end of the document.

methods.name: AddBlankPageFromFormat
methods.doc: AddBlankPageFromFormat appends a blank page using a predefined page format.

methods.name: InsertBlankPage
methods.doc: InsertBlankPage inserts a blank page at the given 1-based position.

methods.name: InsertBlankPageFromFormat
methods.doc: InsertBlankPageFromFormat inserts a blank page at the given position using a predefined page format.

methods.name: Rotate
methods.doc: Rotate rotates selected pages clockwise by angle (Rotate90, Rotate180, or Rotate270).

methods.name: SetRotation
methods.doc: SetRotation sets selected pages to exactly angle (Rotate0, Rotate90, Rotate180, or Rotate270), replacing any existing rotation.

methods.name: Reorder
methods.doc: Reorder rearranges pages according to order, a slice of 1-based page numbers.

methods.name: DeletePage
methods.doc: DeletePage removes the page at the given 1-based number.

methods.name: DeletePages
methods.doc: DeletePages removes the pages at the given 1-based page numbers.

methods.name: Split
methods.doc: Split returns each page of the document as a separate *Document.

methods.name: Extract
methods.doc: Extract returns a new Document containing only the pages in the specified ranges.

methods.name: SaveDocx
methods.doc: SaveDocx writes the document as a Word (.docx) file.

methods.name: WriteDocx
methods.doc: WriteDocx writes the document as a Word (.docx) package to w.

methods.name: EmbeddedFiles
methods.doc: EmbeddedFiles returns the document-level embedded-file collection.

methods.name: SaveEpub
methods.doc: SaveEpub writes the document as an EPUB file.

methods.name: WriteEpub
methods.doc: WriteEpub writes the document as an EPUB 3 package to w.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Flatten bakes the document's interactive form fields into static page content and removes the AcroForm, so the result renders identically but is no longer fillable.

methods.name: NewFlow
methods.doc: NewFlow creates a flow that renders into the document d.

methods.name: LoadFont
methods.doc: LoadFont reads a TTF file, parses it, embeds it into the document, and returns a Font that can be used in TextStyle.Font.

methods.name: LoadFontFromStream
methods.doc: LoadFontFromStream is like LoadFont but reads from an io.Reader.

methods.name: LoadFontByName
methods.doc: LoadFontByName resolves a font by family name (with an optional bold / italic style) through the FontRepository — the folders and files registered with AddFontFolder / AddFontFile first, then the operating system's font directories — embeds the matched face into the document, and returns a Font usable in TextStyle.Font.

methods.name: SubsetFonts
methods.doc: SubsetFonts shrinks every embedded TTF (loaded via LoadFont) to only the glyphs actually drawn, replacing each /FontFile2 with a rebuilt subset program and switching the CIDFont's /CIDToGIDMap from /Identity to a stream that maps the original glyph IDs (still used verbatim as CIDs in content streams) to the compact subset glyph IDs.

methods.name: Form
methods.doc: Form returns the document's AcroForm.

methods.name: CreateForm
methods.doc: CreateForm creates an empty Form XObject of the given size (points).

methods.name: ImportForm
methods.doc: ImportForm copies a Form XObject (and its whole resource graph: fonts, images, nested forms, …) from another document into this one, returning a new XForm ready to place with Page.AddForm.

methods.name: ConvertToGrayscale
methods.doc: ConvertToGrayscale converts the document to grayscale in place: every device colour set in a content stream (text, vector graphics), every raster image, shading and annotation colour is mapped to its luminance grey.

methods.name: SaveHTML
methods.doc: SaveHTML writes the document as an HTML file — self-contained by default; with ResourceDir/ResourceWriter the heavy parts become external files, and with SplitPages each page becomes its own <stem>_p<N>.html.

methods.name: WriteHTML
methods.doc: WriteHTML writes the document as a single self-contained HTML file to w: per page, a raster background under a text layer (transparent in HTMLModeFaithful, visible in HTMLModeText) and link-annotation overlays.

methods.name: ExtractImages
methods.doc: ExtractImages returns images from all pages (one slice per page).

methods.name: ImageInfos
methods.doc: ImageInfos returns image metadata for all pages (one slice per page) without decoding pixel data.

methods.name: OptimizeImages
methods.doc: OptimizeImages optimizes all images in the document to reduce file size.

methods.name: NUp
methods.doc: NUp returns a new Document that imposes this document's pages onto larger sheets in a Rows×Cols grid (e.g.

methods.name: Booklet
methods.doc: Booklet returns a new Document that imposes this document's pages two-up, reordered for saddle-stitch binding: print double-sided, fold the stack in half, and the pages read in order.

methods.name: JavaScript
methods.doc: JavaScript returns the document-level JavaScript collection.

methods.name: SaveLinearized
methods.doc: SaveLinearized writes the document to outputPath as a linearized ("fast web view") PDF (ISO 32000-1 Annex F): the first page's objects and a hint table sit at the front so a viewer can render page 1 before the whole file has downloaded.

methods.name: WriteToLinearized
methods.doc: WriteToLinearized writes the document as a linearized PDF to w (implements an io.WriterTo-style contract).

methods.name: SaveMarkdown
methods.doc: SaveMarkdown writes the document as a Markdown file.

methods.name: WriteMarkdown
methods.doc: WriteMarkdown writes the document as Markdown to w.

methods.name: Info
methods.doc: Info returns the Info-dictionary metadata from this document.

methods.name: SetInfo
methods.doc: SetInfo replaces the document's Info dictionary with the given metadata.

methods.name: ClearInfo
methods.doc: ClearInfo removes the Info dictionary entirely.

methods.name: NamedDestinations
methods.doc: NamedDestinations returns the document's named-destination collection.

methods.name: OpenAction
methods.doc: OpenAction returns the action the viewer runs when the document is opened (/Catalog/OpenAction per ISO 32000-1 §12.3.2 / §12.6.1), or nil when none is set.

methods.name: SetOpenAction
methods.doc: SetOpenAction sets the action run when the document opens.

methods.name: RemoveOpenAction
methods.doc: RemoveOpenAction clears any /Catalog/OpenAction.

methods.name: Optimize
methods.doc: Optimize reduces the document's size in place per opts and returns a report of what changed.

methods.name: AddLayer
methods.doc: AddLayer creates a new layer (OCG) named name and registers it in the document's optional-content properties.

methods.name: Layers
methods.doc: Layers returns the document's layers (OCGs), in /OCProperties/OCGs order.

methods.name: Outlines
methods.doc: Outlines returns the document's root outline collection.

methods.name: SetPageLabels
methods.doc: SetPageLabels installs the document's /PageLabels number tree so PDF viewers display labels like "i, ii, 1, 2, …" in the navigation pane and page indicators.

methods.name: ClearPageLabels
methods.doc: ClearPageLabels removes the document's /PageLabels entry.

methods.name: Paragraphs
methods.doc: Paragraphs returns the structured text of every page.

methods.name: ConvertToPDFA
methods.doc: ConvertToPDFA adjusts the document toward a PDF/A "b"-level conformance profile and returns a validation report describing any violations that remain.

methods.name: ValidateRedactions
methods.doc: ValidateRedactions performs a pre-flight dry-run parseability check on every page that has at least one RedactAnnotation.

methods.name: ApplyRedactions
methods.doc: ApplyRedactions destructively removes content (text glyphs, image XObjects, paths) inside every /Redact annotation's /QuadPoints (or /Rect if /QuadPoints is empty).

methods.name: RenderImage
methods.doc: RenderImage renders the 1-based page number to an image.

methods.name: RenderTIFF
methods.doc: RenderTIFF renders the document to a single multi-page TIFF written to w.

methods.name: ReplaceText
methods.doc: ReplaceText replaces every occurrence of old with replacement across all pages, returning the total number of replacements.

methods.name: Sign
methods.doc: Sign configures a digital signature applied on the next Save/WriteTo.

methods.name: VerifySignatures
methods.doc: VerifySignatures verifies every digital signature in the document and returns one result per signature field, in document order.

methods.name: AddStamp
methods.doc: AddStamp draws a stamp onto the given 1-based pages (all pages when none are given) — convenient for watermarks, headers, footers, and page numbers.

methods.name: LoadSVG
methods.doc: LoadSVG reads and parses an SVG file once, returning a *SVG that can be passed to Page.AddSVGObject or Document.AddSVGObjectWatermark multiple times without re-parsing.

methods.name: LoadSVGFromStream
methods.doc: LoadSVGFromStream is the io.Reader variant of LoadSVG.

methods.name: AddSVGWatermark
methods.doc: AddSVGWatermark applies an SVG watermark to all pages (when pageNums is empty) or to the specified 1-based page numbers.

methods.name: AddSVGWatermarkFromStream
methods.doc: AddSVGWatermarkFromStream is the io.Reader variant of AddSVGWatermark.

methods.name: SetSVGFontResolver
methods.doc: SetSVGFontResolver installs a custom resolver.

methods.name: AddSVGObjectWatermark
methods.doc: AddSVGObjectWatermark uses a pre-parsed *SVG for the watermark content.

methods.name: SaveSVG
methods.doc: SaveSVG exports the document's pages as SVG files.

methods.name: TaggedContent
methods.doc: TaggedContent returns the document's tagged-content facade, creating the structure tree and the /MarkInfo, /ViewerPreferences and /StructTreeRoot catalog entries on first call.

methods.name: ExtractText
methods.doc: ExtractText returns the text content of each page (one entry per page, 0-indexed).

methods.name: AddTextWatermark
methods.doc: AddTextWatermark adds a text watermark to selected pages of the document.

methods.name: ExtractTextWithLayout
methods.doc: ExtractTextWithLayout returns structured text lines for each page.

methods.name: SearchText
methods.doc: SearchText finds every occurrence of query across all pages of the document, returning matches page by page in reading order.

methods.name: GenerateTOC
methods.doc: GenerateTOC builds a table of contents from the document's outline (bookmark) tree and inserts it as new page(s) at the front of the document.

methods.name: ValidatePDFA
methods.doc: ValidatePDFA checks the document against a PDF/A "b"-level conformance profile and returns a report of violations.

methods.name: ValidatePDFUA
methods.doc: ValidatePDFUA checks the document against a subset of PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1, universal accessibility) and returns a report of violations.

methods.name: CreateTilingPattern
methods.doc: CreateTilingPattern creates an empty tiling pattern whose cell is width×height points.

methods.name: SaveXlsx
methods.doc: SaveXlsx writes the document as an Excel (.xlsx) workbook file.

methods.name: WriteXlsx
methods.doc: WriteXlsx writes the document as an Excel (.xlsx) workbook to w.

methods.name: XMP
methods.doc: XMP returns the document's XMP metadata parsed from the /Catalog/Metadata stream.

methods.name: XMPRaw
methods.doc: XMPRaw returns the raw bytes of the XMP packet from /Catalog/Metadata, or nil when the document has no XMP stream.

methods.name: SetXMP
methods.doc: SetXMP serialises meta into a standard XMP packet and stores it as the /Catalog/Metadata stream (uncompressed, /Type /Metadata /Subtype /XML per ISO 32000-1 §14.3.2).

methods.name: SetXMPRaw
methods.doc: SetXMPRaw stores data verbatim as the /Catalog/Metadata stream — an escape hatch for callers that produce their own XMP packet.

methods.name: ClearXMP
methods.doc: ClearXMP removes the /Catalog/Metadata entry.

methods.name: SyncInfoToXMP
methods.doc: SyncInfoToXMP builds an XMP packet from the document's current /Info dictionary and installs it, so the two metadata stores agree (ISO 32000-1 §14.3.2 recommends consistency when both are present).

name: Open
doc: Open opens a PDF file and returns a Document.

name: OpenStream
doc: OpenStream reads a PDF from r and returns a Document.

name: OpenWithPassword
doc: OpenWithPassword opens a password-protected PDF file.

name: OpenStreamWithPassword
doc: OpenStreamWithPassword reads a password-protected PDF from r.

name: PageFormat
doc: PageFormat describes a page size in points (1/72 inch).

methods.name: Landscape
methods.doc: Landscape returns the format with width and height swapped.

name: NewDocument
doc: NewDocument creates a single-page blank document with the given dimensions in points.

name: NewDocumentFromFormat
doc: NewDocumentFromFormat creates a single-page blank document using a predefined page format.

name: TestWriteDocxTextbox
doc: Textbox mode: every paragraph line-cell becomes an absolutely positioned wps text box, pages become sections with their own size.

name: DocRecognitionMode
doc: DocRecognitionMode selects the reconstruction algorithm — mirrors Aspose.PDF for .NET's DocSaveOptions.RecognitionMode.

name: DocSaveOptions
doc: DocSaveOptions configures SaveDocx / WriteDocx.

name: TestWriteDocxTableWithAdjacentBanner
doc: A banner drawn immediately above a table (closer than the cluster merge gap) must not fuse with the table's rulings into one picture — the table content would then appear twice (as w:tbl AND inside the image).

name: TestWriteDocxNoTableTextDoubling
doc: The paragraph extractor freely merges a heading with the rows of the table right below it into one paragraph; table text must still leave the flow (line-granular subtraction) — appearing exactly once, inside w:tbl, with the heading kept.

name: EmbeddedFiles
doc: EmbeddedFiles is the document's collection of attached (embedded) files — the /Catalog/Names/EmbeddedFiles name tree (ISO 32000-1 §7.11.4).

methods.name: Names
methods.doc: Names returns the attachment names (name-tree keys), lexicographically sorted.

methods.name: Count
methods.doc: Count returns the number of embedded files.

methods.name: Has
methods.doc: Has reports whether an attachment with the given name exists.

methods.name: Get
methods.doc: Get returns the named attachment, or nil if absent.

methods.name: All
methods.doc: All returns every attachment, in sorted-name order.

methods.name: Add
methods.doc: Add embeds the file at path under its base name, detecting the MIME type from its extension, and returns the new attachment.

methods.name: AddFromStream
methods.doc: AddFromStream embeds the bytes read from r under the given name (the MIME type is detected from the name's extension), and returns the new attachment.

methods.name: Remove
methods.doc: Remove deletes the named attachment, returning whether it existed.

methods.name: Clear
methods.doc: Clear removes every attachment.

name: EmbeddedFile

name: TestInheritedMediaBox
doc: TestInheritedMediaBox verifies that when /MediaBox lives on a /Pages parent, the leaf /Page still reports correct dimensions after Open.

name: TestInheritedCropBox
doc: TestInheritedCropBox verifies /CropBox inheritance on Page.CropBox() and related box helpers (TrimBox/BleedBox/ArtBox all fall back to CropBox then MediaBox per spec).

name: TestInheritedRotation
doc: TestInheritedRotation verifies /Rotate inheritance on Page.Rotation().

name: TestAddTextWatermarkInheritedMediaBox
doc: TestAddTextWatermarkInheritedMediaBox verifies the public AddTextWatermark API against PDFs with inherited /MediaBox.

name: TestMissingMediaBoxDefaultsToLetter
doc: TestMissingMediaBoxDefaultsToLetter verifies that a page tree with no /MediaBox anywhere falls back to US Letter instead of erroring (47647.pdf, an ACORD XFA form, failed with "render: object 3 not found").

name: TestMistypedLeafPage
doc: TestMistypedLeafPage verifies that a leaf wrongly declared /Type /Pages still opens as a page, renders, and round-trips through Save (regression: 46507.pdf opened with 0 pages; after page-tree acceptance the structural cleanup still dropped the object so rendering failed).

name: PageLabelStyle

name: PageLabelRange
doc: PageLabelRange describes a contiguous run of pages that share a numbering style.

name: TestPageLabelDefaultDecimal
doc: TestPageLabelDefaultDecimal verifies that pages without /PageLabels return their decimal page numbers ("1", "2", …).

name: TestSetPageLabels_RomanThenDecimal
doc: TestSetPageLabels_RomanThenDecimal exercises the typical "front matter + body" pattern: first two pages numbered i, ii (lowercase roman), then the body numbered 1, 2, 3 (decimal restarting at 1).

name: TestSetPageLabels_PrefixAndCustomStart
doc: TestSetPageLabels_PrefixAndCustomStart covers the /P (prefix) and /St (start number) entries — labels like "A-5, A-6, A-7".

name: TestSetPageLabels_Validation
doc: TestSetPageLabels_Validation rejects ranges that don't start at page 1 or aren't strictly ascending.

name: PageRange
doc: PageRange specifies an inclusive range of pages (1-based).

name: MarkupSection
doc: MarkupSection is a column of paragraphs (left-to-right across the page).

name: PageMarkup

name: TestParagraphsSingleColumn
doc: TestParagraphsSingleColumn: two blocks separated by a vertical gap become one section with two paragraphs.

name: TestParagraphsTwoColumns
doc: TestParagraphsTwoColumns: side-by-side blocks become two sections ordered left-to-right, each carrying its own column's text.

name: TestParagraphsEmptyPage
doc: TestParagraphsEmptyPage: a blank page has no sections.

name: TestParagraphsRealFile
doc: TestParagraphsRealFile: a real PDF yields non-empty paragraphs with text and bounding boxes.

name: TestOpenIndirectStreamLength
doc: TestOpenIndirectStreamLength opens a PDF whose content stream uses an indirect /Length (/Length N 0 R) — valid per ISO 32000-1 §7.3.8.2 and emitted by several real-world producers.

name: TestOpenReconstructsBrokenXref
doc: TestOpenReconstructsBrokenXref opens a PDF whose xref subsection header is off by one ("1 N" while the first row is the object-0 free entry, as seen in real producer output).

name: TestOpenBadStartxrefOffsetNoPanic
doc: TestOpenBadStartxrefOffsetNoPanic opens a PDF whose startxref points at a negative offset (-1), as seen in damaged real-world files.

name: TestOpenCROnlyXref
doc: TestOpenCROnlyXref opens a PDF whose cross-reference table uses classic-Mac CR-only (\r) line endings.

name: TestReadStreamDataWrongLength
doc: TestReadStreamDataWrongLength checks that a direct but wrong /Length does not truncate the stream: the reader must verify that "endstream" follows the claimed length and, when it does not, fall back to scanning for the terminator (ISO 32000-1 §7.3.8.1).

name: TestReadStreamDataCorrectLength
doc: TestReadStreamDataCorrectLength confirms the fast path still trusts a correct direct /Length verbatim (the "endstream" verification passes).

name: TestStreamEndIndex
doc: TestStreamEndIndex checks the structure-aware endstream scan used when /Length is indirect, missing, or wrong.

name: TestRunLengthDecode
doc: TestRunLengthDecode covers the RunLengthDecode filter (ISO 32000-1 §7.4.5).

name: TestConvertToPDFAEmbeddedFont
doc: TestConvertToPDFAEmbeddedFont: a document with an embedded font and device colour becomes conformant after conversion and stays conformant after a Save/Open round-trip.

name: TestConvertToPDFAEmbedsStandard14
doc: TestConvertToPDFAEmbedsStandard14: a Standard-14 document becomes fully conformant (the fonts are auto-embedded) and its text survives.

name: TestConvertToPDFAAccessible
doc: TestConvertToPDFAAccessible: a tagged document converts to a fully conformant PDF/A-1a (accessible) file and stays conformant after a round-trip.

name: TestConvertToPDFASymbolRemains
doc: TestConvertToPDFASymbolRemains: Symbol/ZapfDingbats have no Latin substitute and stay a reported violation.

name: TestConvertToPDFAStripsJavaScript
doc: TestConvertToPDFAStripsJavaScript removes document-level JavaScript.

name: TestSRGBICCProfileStructure
doc: TestSRGBICCProfileStructure sanity-checks the generated ICC profile header.

name: TestPermissionsBitPacking
doc: TestPermissionsBitPacking verifies Permissions.toPDFBits produces the Adobe-convention /P value per ISO 32000-1 Table 22: bits 1-2 shall be 0, bits 7-8 and 13-32 shall be 1 (reserved-set-high), and permission bits 3-6 and 9-12 reflect the eight boolean flags.

name: TestEncryptWithCustomPermissionsMatchesPyPDF
doc: TestEncryptWithCustomPermissionsMatchesPyPDF verifies key derivation against an external reference vector produced by pypdf with non-default permissions.

name: TestSetPermissionsPropagatesToSavedFile
doc: TestSetPermissionsPropagatesToSavedFile covers the end-to-end public-API signal: SetPermissions affects what /P the saved file carries.

name: TestSetPasswordWithoutSetPermissionsDefaultsAllowAll
doc: TestSetPasswordWithoutSetPermissionsDefaultsAllowAll preserves backward compatibility: files produced without SetPermissions carry the Adobe all-allow constant 0xFFFFFFFC (= -4 signed).

name: TestBuildTimestampRequest
doc: TestBuildTimestampRequest checks the RFC 3161 TimeStampReq is well-formed: version 1, a SHA-256 imprint of the signature, and certReq set.

name: TestMarshalTimestampUnsignedAttr
doc: TestMarshalTimestampUnsignedAttr checks the token is wrapped as a [1] IMPLICIT SET carrying the signature-time-stamp attribute.

name: TestCoverageBBoxMatchesFullFrame
doc: TestCoverageBBoxMatchesFullFrame guards the P6 performance optimization: the bbox-scoped coverage must agree pixel-for-pixel with the whole-frame coverage inside the bbox, and the whole-frame buffer must be empty outside it.

name: Rectangle
doc: Rectangle represents a PDF rectangle [llx, lly, urx, ury] in points (1/72 inch).

name: TestAppearanceStreamASSelection
doc: TestAppearanceStreamASSelection verifies /AS is authoritative when the /AP/N is a state subdictionary: the named state's stream renders, and an /AS that names a state with no stream (e.g.

name: TestAnnotAppearanceMatrix
doc: TestAnnotAppearanceMatrix maps a 0..100 BBox (identity /Matrix) onto a 200×100 rect at offset (10,20); the matrix must scale ×2/×1 and translate.

name: TestRenderFormWidgetAppearance
doc: TestRenderFormWidgetAppearance checks that form-field widget appearances — which live in /Annots, not the page content stream — are painted by the renderer.

name: TestRenderBlendMultiply
doc: TestRenderBlendMultiply checks the Multiply blend mode: a red rectangle drawn over a green backdrop with /BM /Multiply multiplies to black (green·red = 0), whereas the backdrop elsewhere stays green.

name: TestBlendFuncs
doc: TestBlendFuncs spot-checks a few separable blend functions at known values.

name: TestNonSeparableBlend
doc: TestNonSeparableBlend checks the defining invariants of the non-separable modes: Luminosity gives the result the source's luminosity; Color keeps the backdrop's luminosity.

name: TestSimpleCFFGidUsesEncoding
doc: TestSimpleCFFGidUsesEncoding checks that a simple (non-Type0) CFF font selects glyphs through the CFF code→GID map (simpleGID), not the TrueType cmap path — the fix for embedded Type1C fonts (e.g.

name: TestBuildSimpleEncodingStandardRange
doc: TestBuildSimpleEncodingStandardRange checks the Standard-encoding SID = code−31 correspondence over the predefined ISOAdobe charset (Top DICT charset offset 0 → GID i = SID i): code 'H' (72) → Standard SID 41 → GID 41.

name: TestRenderCFFGlyph
doc: TestRenderCFFGlyph drives the renderer's glyph path with a CFF-backed font: it paints the hand-built square glyph (glyph 1) and checks the rasterizer filled the expected region, proving CFF outlines flow through paintGlyph.

name: TestRenderClipPath
doc: TestRenderClipPath checks that W / W* restricts subsequent painting: a full-page red fill clipped to the left half must leave the right half white.

name: TestRenderClipRestoredByQ
doc: TestRenderClipRestoredByQ checks that a clip set inside q…Q does not leak past the Q that restores the graphics state.

name: TestPostScriptFunction
doc: TestPostScriptFunction checks the Type 4 calculator: arithmetic and ifelse.

name: TestRenderSeparationColor
doc: TestRenderSeparationColor fills with a Separation colour whose tint transform (a Type 4 function) maps tint t → RGB (t,0,0); tint 0.7 must render ~red.

doc: TestZapfDingbatsCheckRendered checks that a non-embedded ZapfDingbats check mark (code '4') now renders via the synthesized outline, so checkbox widget appearances are no longer empty.

name: TestZapfDingbatsMarksRendered
doc: TestZapfDingbatsMarksRendered covers the other canonical checkbox/radio marks.

name: TestZapfDingbatsUnmappedSilent
doc: TestZapfDingbatsUnmappedSilent checks that a code without a synthesized shape draws nothing rather than tofu.

name: TestZapfDingbatsContoursTable
doc: TestZapfDingbatsContoursTable spot-checks the synth table directly.

doc: TestRenderSubsettedEmbeddedFont guards against the regression where a subsetted embedded TTF (SubsetFonts drops cmap/OS-2/name) could not be parsed by the renderer, leaving embedded-font text — e.g.

name: AddFontFolder
doc: AddFontFolder registers a directory searched (recursively) for fonts when rendering.

name: AddFontFile
doc: AddFontFile registers a single font file.

name: AddSystemFonts
doc: AddSystemFonts registers the operating system's standard font directories.

name: ClearFontSources
doc: ClearFontSources removes all registered folders and files.

name: TestSysFamilyPrefix
doc: TestSysFamilyPrefix checks the word-boundary family match used to resolve a non-embedded CJK font to an installed face whose family name is a longer variant of the candidate.

name: TestGroupAlphaNoDoubleDarkening
doc: TestGroupAlphaNoDoubleDarkening: drawing the group at /ca 0.5 must apply the alpha to the flattened result — in the red∕blue overlap the group is pure blue, so the page shows 50% blue over white: (128,128,255)-ish.

name: TestGroupOpaqueInlineUnchanged
doc: TestGroupOpaqueInlineUnchanged: with no group-level alpha/blend/mask the group draws inline (cheap path) and looks exactly like direct painting.

name: TestGroupKnockout
doc: TestGroupKnockout: in a knockout group (/K true) the second square replaces the first where they overlap — drawing both at constant alpha 0.5 *inside* the group must leave the overlap pure 50%-blue (no red contribution), unlike normal accumulation.

name: TestRenderConstantAlphaFill
doc: TestRenderConstantAlphaFill checks the gs operator's /ca (constant fill alpha): a 50%-opaque red fill over a white page must blend to ~(255,128,128).

name: TestRenderOpaqueFillUnaffected
doc: TestRenderOpaqueFillUnaffected guards against the alpha path tinting fully opaque fills: a solid red fill must stay pure red.

name: TestRenderImageMask
doc: TestRenderImageMask draws a 2×2 inline image mask (a diagonal: samples 0 at the top-left and bottom-right paint) with a red fill colour, and checks the mask paints the fill colour on the diagonal and leaves the off-diagonal white.

name: TestRenderInlineImage
doc: TestRenderInlineImage draws a 2×2 red inline image (BI/ID/EI) into a 40×40 box and checks it paints there but not outside.

name: TestRenderOptionalContentHidden
doc: TestRenderOptionalContentHidden checks that content inside a /OC marked-content section whose OCG is OFF in the default config is not drawn, while content outside it renders normally.

name: TestRenderOptionalContentVisible
doc: TestRenderOptionalContentVisible checks the same content renders the red layer when the OCG is not in the OFF set.

name: TestParseOTF
doc: TestParseOTF wraps the hand-built CFF in an OpenType ('OTTO') sfnt and checks parseTTF attaches the CFF and draws glyphs through it — the path a registered .otf font takes in the FontRepository.

name: TestShadingDeviceNTintColor
doc: TestShadingDeviceNTintColor checks that a shading whose colour space is /DeviceN (or /Separation) runs the function output through the tint transform instead of reading the lone component as DeviceGray.

name: TestRenderShOperatorAxial
doc: TestRenderShOperatorAxial drives the `sh` operator directly with a manually built axial shading (black→white, extended both ways) and checks that the whole page becomes a horizontal gradient.

name: TestRenderLinearShadingPattern
doc: TestRenderLinearShadingPattern fills a rectangle with a left-to-right red→blue linear gradient (a PatternType 2 shading pattern) and checks the rendered endpoints.

name: TestRenderThreeStopShadingPattern
doc: TestRenderThreeStopShadingPattern uses a 3-stop gradient (red→green→blue), which the writer emits as a stitching (type 3) function, so it exercises the fnStitching evaluator: the middle of the rectangle must read green.

name: TestRenderRadialShadingPattern
doc: TestRenderRadialShadingPattern fills a rectangle with a radial gradient (white centre → black edge) and checks the centre is light and a corner dark.

name: TestRenderSoftMaskLuminosity
doc: TestRenderSoftMaskLuminosity applies a luminosity soft mask whose group paints a white square over the left half (→ mask 1 left, 0 right), then fills the whole page red: only the unmasked left half should paint.

name: TestStrokeClosedRedundantStartPoint
doc: TestStrokeClosedRedundantStartPoint guards the star-tip bug: a closed path that explicitly draws back to its start point (leaving the last point coincident with the first) must stroke identically to the same path closed with `h` alone.

name: TestStrokeCaps
doc: TestStrokeCaps checks butt / round / square line caps on a horizontal line ending at x=80 (half-width 5).

name: TestStrokeDash
doc: TestStrokeDash checks a [10 10] dash on a horizontal line: on-spans paint, off-spans stay white.

name: TestStrokeMiterVsBevel
doc: TestStrokeMiterVsBevel checks that a miter join fills more of the outer corner than a bevel join, which cuts the spike off.

name: TestSubstitutedGlyphCondensedToDeclaredWidth
doc: TestSubstitutedGlyphCondensedToDeclaredWidth verifies that glyphs of a substituted (non-embedded, not installed) font are condensed horizontally to the document's declared /Widths the way Acrobat and MuPDF do, instead of painting at the substitute's natural width and overlapping.

name: TestMissingFontResourceSubstituted
doc: TestMissingFontResourceSubstituted verifies that text selecting a font absent from /Resources/Font still extracts and renders through the default Helvetica substitute (regression: 44963.pdf rendered its chart but no text).

name: TestRenderCropBoxClampedToMediaBox
doc: TestRenderCropBoxClampedToMediaBox verifies the rendered canvas is the CropBox intersected with the MediaBox per ISO 32000-1 7.7.3.3 (42097.pdf declares a CropBox ~3x larger than its A4 MediaBox, which shrank the content into a corner of an oversized canvas).

name: TestSynthesizeAnnotationAppearanceNoAP
doc: TestSynthesizeAnnotationAppearanceNoAP verifies that drawing annotations without an /AP stream (Square/Circle/Line) are synthesized and rendered the way a viewer does (38730-1.pdf: red square, green circle, blue line had no appearance and were dropped).

name: TestLineAnnotationArrowColor

name: XlsxSaveOptions
doc: XlsxSaveOptions configures SaveXlsx / WriteXlsx.

name: TestWriteXlsxTablesOnly
doc: A drawn table round-trips into a workbook: numeric cells, merges, header fill, and the package invariants.

name: TestWriteXlsxFullPage
doc: FullPage mode: plain page text lands in cells, one sheet per page.

name: TestWriteXlsxEmpty
doc: An empty document still yields a valid single-sheet workbook.

name: XMPProperty
doc: XMPProperty is a single simple (string-valued) XMP property in an arbitrary namespace.

name: XMPMetadata
doc: XMPMetadata is the document's XMP packet modelled as common schema fields plus a list of arbitrary Custom properties.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.doc: IsEmpty reports whether the XMP metadata carries no information.

name: TestXMPRoundTrip
doc: TestXMPRoundTrip writes a full XMP packet, saves, reopens, and reads it back, checking every modelled field survives.

name: TestXMPParseExternal
doc: TestXMPParseExternal parses a packet that mixes the attribute form (pdf:Producer on rdf:Description) with the element form (dc:title in an rdf:Alt, dc:creator in an rdf:Seq), like real-world producers emit.

name: TestXMPClear
doc: TestXMPClear removes the packet so a subsequent read is empty.

name: TestSyncInfoToXMP
doc: TestSyncInfoToXMP maps the /Info dictionary into the XMP packet.
